claim: The stable kernel ABI defines /sys/class/backlight/<backlight>/brightness (since kernel 2.6.12, April 2005) accepting values 0..max_brightness, but the value shown is the level stored in the driver, which may not be the actual brightness — actual_brightness (since 2.6.17, March 2006) is the hardware-queried value.
stance_target: kiosk brightness control in ha-linux-agent must read actual_brightness for truth and treat brightness writes as requests that hardware may clamp; the ABI has been stable since 2.6.12 so building against it is safe
scope_conditions: Linux backlight class ABI (stable); requires backlight driver registered
quoted_support: Control the brightness for this <backlight>. Values are between 0 and max_brightness. This file will also show the brightness level stored in the driver, which may not be the actual brightness (see actual_brightness). ... Show the actual brightness by querying the hardware.
time_period: attributes dated April 2005 / March 2006; stable since

claim: /sys/class/backlight/<backlight>/bl_power takes values compatible with FB_BLANK_* from fb.h: 0 (FB_BLANK_UNBLANK, power on) and 4 (FB_BLANK_POWERDOWN, power off), stable since kernel 2.6.12.
stance_target: agent display blank/restore control uses bl_power with the documented 0/4 values
quoted_support: Control BACKLIGHT power, values are compatible with FB_BLANK_* from fb.h - 0 (FB_BLANK_UNBLANK) : power on. - 4 (FB_BLANK_POWERDOWN) : power off
